newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Wienerberger 1996 pretax down, expects 1997 gain. [CORRECTED 07:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Wienerberger 1996 pretax down, expects 1997 gain. [CORRECTED 07:40 GMT]

text.p: Austrian brick maker Wienerberger Baustoffindustrie said on Tuesday final 1996 group pretax profit eased to 1.37 billion (corrects from 1.60 billion) schillings from 1.495 billion (corrects from 1.67 billion) a year earlier.

In a statement released ahead of its annual earnings news conference, the group said earnings before taxes and interest (EBIT) fell to 1.60 billion (corrects from 1.37 billion) schillings from 1.67 billion (corrects from 1.495 billion) a year earlier.

Wienerberger said it expected 1997 earnings to increase by 25 percent. The group did not specify which profit figure it was referring to. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274 ($ = 11.98 Austrian Schillings)
